title: 广播规则：成功与失败的多组形状对照
expected_output:
(3, 4) 乘 (4,)            -> (3, 4)  可以广播
(3, 1) 乘 (1, 4)          -> (3, 4)  可以广播
(3, 4) 乘 (3, 1)          -> (3, 4)  可以广播
(5,) 乘 (2, 3)            -> 失败 (shape mismatch: objects cannot be broadcast )
(2, 3, 4) 乘 (3, 1)       -> (2, 3, 4)  可以广播
(2, 3) 乘 (4,)            -> 失败 (shape mismatch: objects cannot be broadcast )
(1,) 乘 (0,)              -> (0,)  可以广播
--- broadcast_to 不复制内存 ---
broadcast_to 共享内存 = True | shape = (3, 4)
broadcast_to 得到的数组只读 : True
--- 真正的运算会物化结果 ---
x + zeros((3,4)) shape = (3, 4) | 共享内存 = False
code:
import numpy as np


def bc(*shapes):
    try:
        return "-> %s  可以广播" % (np.broadcast_shapes(*shapes),)
    except ValueError as exc:
        return "-> 失败 (%s)" % str(exc)[:44]


cases = [((3, 4), (4,)),
         ((3, 1), (1, 4)),
         ((3, 4), (3, 1)),
         ((5,), (2, 3)),
         ((2, 3, 4), (3, 1)),
         ((2, 3), (4,)),
         ((1,), (0,))]
for shapes in cases:
    print("%-24s %s" % (" 乘 ".join(map(str, shapes)), bc(*shapes)))
print("--- broadcast_to 不复制内存 ---")
x = np.arange(4)
y = np.broadcast_to(x, (3, 4))
print("broadcast_to 共享内存 =", np.shares_memory(x, y), "| shape =", y.shape)
print("broadcast_to 得到的数组只读 :", not y.flags["WRITEABLE"])
print("--- 真正的运算会物化结果 ---")
z = x + np.zeros((3, 4))
print("x + zeros((3,4)) shape =", z.shape, "| 共享内存 =", np.shares_memory(x, z))
